bar.navigation.products.label: Products
bar.navigation.price-lists.label: Price lists
bar.navigation.outlets.label: Outlets
bar.screens.products.colour-help: Always shown beside the category's name, never on its own.
bar.screens.products.empty: Start with a category, such as Draught, Wine, Soft drinks or Snacks, then add the products in it.
bar.screens.products.name: Name
bar.screens.products.name-help: What a customer asks for, such as House lager or Programme.
bar.screens.products.first-size-help: Such as Pint or 175 ml. Leave it empty for a product sold in one size; more sizes can be added on its page.
bar.screens.products.standard-price-help: Leave it empty to set it later. A size with no price cannot be sold.
bar.screens.products.age-check-help: The till asks whether the customer looks under the challenge age before selling it.
bar.screens.product.size-name-help: Such as Pint, Half or 250 ml. A product sold in one size has one called Each, which the till does not show.
bar.screens.product.price-help-standard: Leave it empty to stop selling this size.
bar.screens.product.price-help: Leave it empty to take this size off the list. Where the list follows Standard, it then sells at Standard's price.
bar.screens.product.later: Start later, such as for a planned rise
bar.screens.product.price-saved: Price saved. Sales already rung up keep their price.
bar.screens.lists.standard: Standard: every other list starts from it
bar.screens.lists.by-hand-falls-back: Priced by hand, otherwise as Standard
bar.screens.lists.name: Name
bar.screens.lists.percent-off-help: Each price is Standard's less this, rounded to the nearest penny. It follows any change to Standard at once.
bar.screens.lists.falls-back: Use Standard's price where this list has none
bar.screens.lists.falls-back-help: Otherwise a size with no price on this list cannot be sold from it.
bar.screens.lists.restricted-help: Only people allowed to use restricted lists can choose it at the till, such as for committee prices.
bar.screens.lists.standard-help: Standard is the bar's ordinary prices. Set them on each product's page.
bar.screens.lists.percent-help: Every price here is Standard's less {percent}%, so it changes when Standard does.
bar.screens.lists.hand-help: Prices on this list are set on each product's page.
bar.screens.lists.unknown: There is no such price list.
bar.screens.outlets.empty: An outlet is a place that sells: the foyer bar, an interval kiosk, or the box office desk.
bar.screens.outlets.name: Name
bar.screens.outlets.name-help: Such as Foyer bar or Interval kiosk.
bar.screens.outlets.kind-help: One outlet can be the box office desk: drinks sold beside tickets come from it.
bar.screens.outlets.space-help: Optional. Shown on the Tonight screen.
